newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's November zinc output rises 14.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's November zinc output rises 14.1 percent.

text.p: Peru's mined zinc output rose 14.1 percent to 67,227 tonnes in November compared to the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from Energy and Mines Ministry released Friday.
Production rose 9.1 percent to 690,165 tonnes in the first 11 months of the year against the same period last year.
In 1995, zinc output edged down 0.2 percent to 688,619 tonnes from 690,017 tonnes in 1994.
Peru is the world's fourth largest zinc producer. State-run mining giant Centromin Peru is the country's largest producer of the metal.
